en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a man in military uniform standing with arms crossed in front of a rustic wooden structure, likely a hut or barracks, set among pine trees. The handwritten caption below the photo indicates the identity of the person and the location. The reverse side has handwritten correspondence in German and an address, showing it was used as a traditional postcard.
